# Leyline

> Graphs\, organized by organization\.

Every page below is Markdown. Requests are JSON over HTTP; each operation's page gives its method and URI, its headers, its request and response with an example, its errors and its pagination. Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` unless an operation's page says it takes no credential. Send `Crucible-Version: 2026-09-04` on every request you make. `describe.json` holds the whole reference as data (`crucible.describe/1`).

## Overview

- [Service overview](src/index.md): protocol, authentication, service errors, and the operations of each resource
- [Roles](src/roles.md): every role a binding names, the scopes it binds at, and what it grants

## Operations

- [CreateBackup](src/operations/API_CreateBackup.md): `POST /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/backups`. Granted by `owner` or `backupAdmin` at `organization`.
- [CreateGraph](src/operations/API_CreateGraph.md): `POST /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/graphs`. Granted by `graphCreator` at `organization`; `graphAdmin` at `allGraphs`.
- [DeleteGraph](src/operations/API_DeleteGraph.md): `DELETE /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/graphs/{graphId}`. Granted by `graphAdmin` at `allGraphs` or `graph`.
- [GetGraph](src/operations/API_GetGraph.md): `GET /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/graphs/{graphId}`. Granted by `graphReader`, `graphWriter` or `graphAdmin` at `allGraphs` or `graph`.
- [GetGraphHistory](src/operations/API_GetGraphHistory.md): `GET /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/histories/{historyId}`. Granted by `owner` at `organization`; `historyReader` or `historyAdmin` at `allHistories` or `history`; `graphAdmin` at `allGraphs` or `graph`, as the service decides (the history of a graph this binding covers, while the graph is live).
- [GetOrganization](src/operations/API_GetOrganization.md): `GET /v1/organizations/{organizationId}`. Granted by `owner`, `accessAdmin`, `graphGroupAdmin`, `usageViewer`, `auditViewer`, `auditAdmin`, `backupViewer` or `backupAdmin` at `organization`.
- [GetUsage](src/operations/API_GetUsage.md): `GET /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/usage`. Granted by `owner` or `usageViewer` at `organization`.
- [ListAuditEvents](src/operations/API_ListAuditEvents.md): `GET /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/audit-events`. Granted by `owner`, `auditViewer` or `auditAdmin` at `organization`.
- [ListGraphHistories](src/operations/API_ListGraphHistories.md): `GET /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/histories`. The histories the caller may read\. What the caller sees is granted by `owner` at `organization`; `historyReader` or `historyAdmin` at `allHistories` or `history`; `graphAdmin` at `allGraphs` or `graph`, as the service decides (the history of a graph this binding covers, while the graph is live).
- [ListRoles](src/operations/API_ListRoles.md): `GET /v1/roles`. Every role a binding may name\.
- [PutRoleBinding](src/operations/API_PutRoleBinding.md): `PUT /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/role-bindings/{principal}`. Grants role to principal at scope\, replacing the role a binding there held\: the role granted and the role replaced must each be one the caller may assign\. Granted by `owner` or `accessAdmin` at `organization`.
- [RestoreGraphHistory](src/operations/API_RestoreGraphHistory.md): `POST /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/histories/{historyId}/restore`. Granted by `owner` at `organization`; `historyAdmin` at `allHistories` or `history`.
- [RevokeRoleBinding](src/operations/API_RevokeRoleBinding.md): `POST /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/role-bindings/{principal}/revoke`. Revokes the binding principal holds at scope\: the role it held must be one the caller may assign\. Granted by `owner` or `accessAdmin` at `organization`.
- [WriteGraph](src/operations/API_WriteGraph.md): `POST /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/graphs/{graphId}/writes`. Granted by `graphWriter` or `graphAdmin` at `allGraphs` or `graph`.
